title: Runner-Up
statementMd:
Print the **second largest distinct** value among n integers. If every value is the same (there is no second distinct value), print `-1`.

**Input**
Line 1: `n` (2 ≤ n ≤ 1000). Line 2: n integers (between −10⁶ and 10⁶).

**Output**
The second largest distinct value, or `-1`.
hints: Track two values while scanning once: the largest and the second largest so far.
When you find a new largest, the old largest becomes second. Skip values equal to the largest.
